desc:
Fly a real-looking fighter jet and fight for the top of the board.

Launch off an island carrier deck or a snowy fjord airbase on full afterburner, climb into golden hour clouds, get a lock and SPLASH your enemy. Missile on your tail? Drop flares, dive into a valley and lose it behind a mountain.

✈️ Photoreal jets, 3D clouds and hazy sunlit skies
🗺️ Two maps: a tropical island and the Twin Fjords, snowy peaks and deep valleys
🎯 Guns, flares and 16 missiles and bombs
🎮 Four modes: Free For All, Blimp Hunt, Blimp War and 6v6 (one life, last team flying wins)
🆕 NEW: the Dart, a tiny, lightning quick dogfighter
🛠️ Earn credits to unlock jets, upgrade them and paint them
🎓 Quick training flight for new pilots, or jump straight in with a friend

PC: left click fires, right click aims, 1 to 3 or scroll picks a weapon, F drops flares. Phone and controller supported.

Join BoomBlox Games for updates
